meta.title: RITMO — find your rhythm
meta.description: Online ballroom dance lessons. Latin at your pace, with personal support from your coach.

hero.photoAlt: A couple performing a ballroom dance
hero.lead1: From your first step to confident dancing.
hero.lead2: Latin at your pace — with personal support from your coach.
hero.imageLabel: FEEL THE MUSIC. OWN THE FLOOR.

intro.line1: Choose a program, then a dance and a format.
intro.line2: Each dance is a standalone course.
intro.line3: All the dances together make a complete program.

approach.body: No partner or experience needed. Just a little space and a desire to move. Watch the lessons, practice and work with your coach on what matters to you.

understand.title: Understand the movement
understand.body: Four progressive lessons: foundations, technique, a combination and practice.

format.title: Find your format
format.body: Videos on their own, videos + 1 private lesson, or videos + 4 private lessons.

complete.title: Complete the program
complete.body: Finish each dance and move to the next level — at your own pace.

partner.question: Do I need a partner or previous experience?
partner.answer: Not for the introductory courses. The exercises are designed for solo practice. You just need enough space and comfortable clothes.

singleDance.question: Can I purchase just one dance?
singleDance.answer: Yes. Each dance is a separate course with 4 lessons and its own package. Complete all 3 dances to finish Intro, or all 5 for Beginner.

privateLessons.question: How do private lessons work?
privateLessons.answer: Personal and Mentorship packages include private lessons. They are scheduled with your coach on a separate booking platform, not on this site.
